The redesign release — the desktop editor moves into one dark world (sidebar, top bar, dark modals), the tile editor is rebuilt around Appearance and Behavior, the Android app takes the same palette and a new logo lands everywhere.

## Highlights

- **Dark editor shell.** The rail and light board list merge into a dark sidebar (brand, boards with swatch and size, server card, Settings); the board header becomes a top bar (title + size chip, undo/redo, zoom, Touch mode, board menu); modals, pickers and menus follow the dark tokens. Chrome typography is Inter with Lucide icons — tile faces keep Roboto and Font Awesome so they render exactly as on the tablet.
- **Rebuilt tile editor.** The edit dialog splits into two columns: Appearance (preview on the board color, label, icon/image, shape and text position as segmented controls, the five colors as visible swatches with hex/None one click away) and Behavior (tile mode, action, its options). Toggle tiles preview both states, keystrokes render as key caps with a press-to-record recorder, and gestures are switch cards that only appear for button/toggle tiles.
- **Fit-to-canvas board.** The board fits the canvas by default and scales as one picture, so tile faces keep their proportions; touch mode fills the window the same way. The canvas gains a dot grid and dashed open slots for empty cells.
- **New Pulpit logo.** A capital P built from deck keys, on desktop (multi-size `icon.ico` 16–256 px replacing the 32 px placeholder, sidebar mark, favicon) and Android (adaptive launcher icon with a themed monochrome layer, a proper alpha-only notification icon).
- **Redesigned Android chrome.** The connect screen is two-column on tablets (brand and steps beside the pairing card, segmented Auto/Manual, discovered PCs as rows), with a glass board chip and the link status as a card over the blurred deck. Tile faces keep Roboto and their colors.
- **Lighter build.** Webfonts are WOFF2-only and limited to the subsets the UI meets: the frontend embedded in the exe drops from 3.0 MB to 1.0 MB.
- **Runs on Linux.** The editor builds and launches on Linux; the Voicemeeter integration reports itself unavailable and the self-update guard stays Windows-only.

## Fixes

- **Zoom buttons.** The -/+ zoom buttons were no-ops — `bumpZoom(±0.1)` stepped by 1%, which the rounding swallowed.
- **Selection ring.** It only showed in touch mode, where nothing is selectable; it now marks selected tiles in the editor.
- **Tile faces.** 1 px light rim on the top edge, label/glyph shadows on Android like the desktop, and the glyph grows on multi-cell keys (`tileIconScale`, same table on both sides).
- **Android notification icon.** The old colored launcher vector rendered as a blob in the status bar; it is now a proper alpha-only icon.
- **Settings language select** no longer stretches over the row label.

## Install

- **Desktop**: update in-app or grab `pulpit-desktop-1.8.0.exe` below — the updater feed is pointing here.
- **Android**: install `pulpit-1.8.0.apk` over the previous version.
